baslik: Ressamım · Step-by-step drawing lessons for kids
aciklama: Ressamım teaches children aged 4–12 to draw, step by step, with a friendly teacher. No ads, no personal data. Watch the free parts of the app in short videos.
og_aciklama: The teacher draws first, then the child draws. Ages 4–12, 11 languages, no ads.
hero_h1: Your child learns to draw, step by step
hero_metin: In Ressamım, the teacher draws every line first and gives a small tip. Then it is the child's turn. From simple shapes to watercolor, at their own pace.
video_ders: Screen recording of the sun lesson
video_atolye: Screen recording of free drawing and a coloring page in the studio
video_oyun: Screen recording of the Mix the colors game
nasil_metin: Every lesson has a few short steps. Each step has the same three parts.
adim1_p: Draws the line slowly on screen and explains it out loud.
adim2_p: A short, simple technique tip, like "Look, my hand goes round."
adim3_p: The child draws the same line with a finger or a stylus and collects stars.
ucretsiz_metin: Download the app and start right away. Part of every area is free. The videos are screen recordings of the app itself.
ders_ozet: The first 3 lessons of each of the four sections.
ders_li: Watercolor and Color: the first three lessons each
ders_kilit: Each section has 50 lessons. The rest open with the family membership.
atolye_li: One tap saves the drawing to My drawings
atolye_kilit: The watercolor brush, all 12 colors and 50 coloring pages come with the membership.

The child picks two primary colors and sees the result

uyelik_metin: One membership covers all the children in the family. Prices are shown inside the app, after a parent check.

e2_p: No accounts, nothing about your child is collected. Drawings stay on the device.

sss: Ages 4–12. The app starts at the child's age: the Little Ones section for ages 4–6, and Pencil, Watercolor and Color for older children.
Do I need to enter payment details for the free part?
No. Download the app and use the free parts right away. The membership is optional.
Which devices does it run on?
iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets. Children can draw with a finger or a stylus.
The teacher's voice is downloaded the first time and saved on the device. After that it also works offline.
11 languages: Turkish, English, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Arabic, Bengali, French, Russian, Portuguese and Urdu. The app follows the phone's language, and you can change it in the parents' area.
How do I cancel the membership?
At any time, in your App Store or Google Play account settings.
